mapper.select: SELECT u.upload_id FROM t_file_object f JOIN t_file_upload u ON u.upload_id=f.upload_id WHERE f.file_id=#{fileId} AND f.creation_source='UPLOAD' AND u.uploader_id=#{accountId} AND u.status='COMPLETED' AND u.owner_system='CCT' AND u.owner_type='CLIENT_APPLICATION_SUBJECT' AND f.storage_provider=u.storage_provider AND f.storage_container_ref=u.storage_container_ref AND f.storage_object_ref=u.storage_object_ref AND f.scan_policy_id=u.scan_policy_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_file_owner_ref o WHERE o.file_id=f.file_id AND o.owner_system=u.owner_system AND o.owner_type=u.owner_type AND o.owner_ref_id=u.owner_ref_id AND o.purpose_code='CLIENT_ONBOARDING_MATERIAL')

SELECT upload_id,tenant_id,uploader_id,owner_ref_id,display_name,expected_size,expected_mime,storage_provider, storage_container_ref AS container_ref,storage_object_ref AS object_ref,scan_policy_id,expires_time AS expires_at,status FROM t_file_upload WHERE upload_id=#{id} AND owner_system='CCT' AND owner_type='CLIENT_APPLICATION_SUBJECT' FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.requirement_id AS id,r.scanner_code,r.scan_type AS type,r.minimum_scanner_version AS minimum_version, r.accepted_result_codes AS accepted_codes,s.result_code FROM t_file_scan_requirement r JOIN t_file_scan_policy p ON p.policy_id=r.policy_id LEFT JOIN t_file_scan_result s ON s.file_id=#{fileId} AND s.scan_requirement_id=r.requirement_id AND s.scan_policy_id=r.policy_id AND s.attempt_no=1 WHERE r.policy_id=#{policyId} ORDER BY r.requirement_no
mapper.update: UPDATE t_file_upload SET status='COMPLETED',version=version+1,update_time=#{now} WHERE upload_id=#{id} AND status IN ('CREATED','UPLOADING') AND expires_time > #{now}
UPDATE t_file_object SET scan_status=#{status},available_time=CASE WHEN #{status}='AVAILABLE' THEN #{now} ELSE NULL END,version=version+1,update_time=#{now} WHERE file_id=#{id}
